error.checksumMismatch: Verification failed for "%@": the %@ digest does not match (expected %@, got %@). The data may have been corrupted during transfer; it will be transferred once more automatically.
error.cloneFailed: Could not clone "%@" using APFS (%@); automatically switched to a standard copy. The result is unaffected.
error.destinationUnwritable: Cannot write to "%@". Check that the destination folder exists and is writable.
error.diskFull: Not enough disk space: %@ required, %@ available. Free some space and try again.
error.fileBusy: The file "%@" is in use by another application. Close it and try again.
error.networkUnavailable: Network unavailable; cannot reach "%@" (%@). Check the connection and try again.
error.pathTooLong: The path is %d bytes long, exceeding the macOS limit of 1024 bytes; cannot access "%@". Shorten the directory names and try again.
error.permissionDenied: No permission to read "%@". Grant MacCopy Full Disk Access in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
error.sourceChangedDuringCopy: The source file "%@" changed during copying. To avoid a damaged file, this copy was stopped. Please start again.
error.sourceUnreadable: Cannot read the source file "%@" (%@). Make sure it still exists and is readable.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred: %@. Try again; if it persists, check the MacCopy log.
error.volumeNotFound: Volume "%@" not found. Make sure the disk is connected and mounted.
